title: MXL - Node flow overview
description: State, timing and storage of the MXL flows on one node, from mxl-exporter.

panels.title: Flows
panels.description: Flows currently present in the selected domains.

targets.expr:
count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active
panels.description: Present flows whose head index advanced between the last two exporter collections.

targets.expr:
count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Stalled
panels.description: Present flows whose head index did not advance. The writer stopped or hangs.

targets.expr:
count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
((mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 0))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Removed
panels.description: Flows that disappeared from the domain but are still tracked by the exporter (until --flow-lifetime expires, 24h by default).

targets.expr:
count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 0)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Domains
panels.description: Domains the exporter tracks on this node.

targets.expr: count(mxl_domain_num_flows{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Worst latency
panels.description: Highest flow latency: how far the head index trails the current time, converted with the flow's grain rate.

targets.expr:
max(
(mxl_flow_latency_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

panels.title: Flows
panels.description: One row per flow. Latency and buffer depth are converted from grains (samples for audio) with the flow rate. Last write/read are only reported for discrete (video/data) flows; continuous flows do not update these timestamps.

targets.expr:
max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} + mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(mxl_flow_latency_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
((mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} or mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_samples{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000)
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(clamp_min(timestamp(mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) - (mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / 1e9 - 37), 0) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(clamp_min(timestamp(mxl_flow_last_read_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) - (mxl_flow_last_read_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / 1e9 - 37), 0) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (
(mxl_flow_channels_total{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

panels.title: Flows by state
panels.description: Active: head index advancing. Stalled: present but not advancing. Removed: gone from the domain but still tracked by the exporter. Per-flow state is in the collapsed rows at the bottom.

targets.expr:
count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} + mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
) == 2) or vector(0)

count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} + mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
) == 1) or vector(0)

count(max by (flow_id, domain) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} + mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Latency by data type
panels.description: How far the head index trails the current time. Removed flows are left out. Per-flow series are in the collapsed row below.

targets.expr:
max by (flow_data_type) (
((mxl_flow_latency_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

quantile by (flow_data_type) (0.5,
((mxl_flow_latency_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

panels.title: Grain rate vs nominal
panels.description: Head index advance rate divided by the declared grain rate. 100% means the writer keeps up with real time. Removed flows are left out. Short-window jitter of a few tenths of a percent is scrape timing.

targets.expr:
min by (flow_data_type) (
((rate(mxl_flow_head_index_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) / (mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_data_type) (
((rate(mxl_flow_head_index_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}[$__rate_interval]) / (mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

panels.title: Write age (discrete flows)
panels.description: Time between the exporter's collection and the flow's last write. A healthy writer stays around one grain period. Removed flows are left out. Continuous (audio) flows do not update the write timestamp.

targets.expr:
max by (flow_data_type) (
((clamp_min(timestamp(mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) - (mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / 1e9 - 37), 0) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

quantile by (flow_data_type) (0.5,
((clamp_min(timestamp(mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) - (mxl_flow_last_write_time_ns{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / 1e9 - 37), 0) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) mxl_flow_ring_buffer_size_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"}) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type=~"$data_type"})
)

panels.title: Domains
panels.description: Data size sums the files of all flow directories in the domain. Filesystem usage covers the whole filesystem, which several domains can share.

targets.expr: max by (domain, fs_path) (mxl_domain_fs_space_used_bytes{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_domain_fs_space_total_bytes{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
max by (domain, fs_path) (mxl_domain_fs_space_available_bytes{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
max by (domain) (mxl_domain_size_bytes{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})

panels.title: Flow state: $data_type
panels.description: Active: head index advancing. Stalled: present but not advancing. Removed: gone from the domain.

targets.expr:
max by (flow_id, domain, flow_group_name, flow_group_type) (
(mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} + mxl_flow_active{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"})
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type="$data_type"})
)

max by (flow_id, domain, flow_group_name, flow_group_type) (
((mxl_flow_latency_grains{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * mxl_flow_rate_den{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} / mxl_flow_rate_num{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} * 1000) and on(flow_id, node, domain, pod) (mxl_flow_present{node="$node", domain=~"$domain"} == 1))
  * on(flow_id, node, domain) group_left(flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type)
  max by (flow_id, node, domain, flow_label, flow_group_name, flow_group_type, flow_data_type, flow_media_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node="$node", domain=~"$domain", flow_data_type="$data_type"})
)
